_hitmanharry_: At the depot, Rafael Hitmanharry had practised answering to his name. At S-C10, the first person to call it only wanted help with a crate.
Victory at Blackwater Canal. Rafael Hitmanharry let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
actual.red: By the time Wendel Red reached S-F1, the war was 4 days old and had its own habits. He learned the first one within the hour: keep your head down.

A bullet found Wendel Red at S-F1, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Oskar Perry of the Hegemony (@bo.perry._). Mail came up the line with a letter for Wendel Red. Wendel Red read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. News of the loss of Hill 304 reached S-F1 with the rations. Wendel Red ate while listening to the revised orders.
A bed came free in the hospital dugout, and Wendel Red was carried in at last.
A surgeon stopped at Wendel Red's bed, checked the dressing and moved on without a word. He decided that was good news.
Wendel Red came back fit for duty and discovered the section had changed the recipe for its tea. He demanded an explanation.
A round came through a gap in the sandbags at S-F1 and grazed Wendel Red's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Pavel Yijoon of the Hegemony (@yijoon09).

Wendel Red came back to the squad today. The men had kept his spot on the fire step and his spoon. The Hegemony hold Blackwater Canal now, and they can see straight into S-F1. Wendel Red has learned to walk bent double.
duncan_w_0412: Cyril Duncan found a place in T-F2 between a snorer and a man who talked in his sleep. The available alternative was under the leak.
The Hegemony hold Blackwater Canal now, and they can see straight into T-F2. Cyril Duncan has learned to walk bent double.
ethanlam724: At the depot, Gustav Ethanlam had practised answering to his name. At R-S11, the first person to call it only wanted help with a crate.
Gustav Ethanlam brought sandbags forward and found the damage worse than the message had said. The party went back for another load.
Gustav Ethanlam and Jonas "Saint" Carrsonhartw divided a parcel using a tin lid as scales. The last crumb needed a second opinion.
At Saint-Ash crossroads, Gustav Ethanlam of the Hegemony and Bram Freddie of the Concord spent the morning shooting at the same loose sheet of metal. The sheet kept winning.
Asked what he will do after the war, Gustav Ethanlam said: 'Be a shepherd in Esterhaus. And never complain about anything, ever again.'

The gun at R-S11 jammed twice and fired once. Once was enough: Nils Ewalters, grazed. Blackwater Canal has been won. Gustav Ethanlam listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.
iqsanislami: The new sniper gave his name as Felix Iqsanislami. The corporal looked at his boots, then at the mud, and laughed for the first time in a week.
Word came down the line: Blackwater Canal is ours. Felix Iqsanislami shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.
oaustin77: Viktor Oaustin, a lamplighter from Brennmoor, was sent forward on Day 6 to fill a gap in R-S10. The gap had a name once. Nobody says it.

Viktor Oaustin lost a boot to the mud at R-S10. It took two men and a rifle sling to get it back. The mud kept the sock. Mail came up the line with a letter for Viktor Oaustin. Viktor Oaustin read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Fog hid the far end of R-S10. Viktor Oaustin kept counting the turns so as not to walk past the dugout. Mail came up the line with a letter for Viktor Oaustin. Viktor Oaustin read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
Viktor Oaustin discovered three men claiming the next place on the leave roster. Each had a different copy of the list.
Viktor Oaustin hauled ammunition boxes up the communication trench all night. His back filed a formal complaint.
The Hegemony won Blackwater Canal. In R-S10, Viktor Oaustin listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
streekluukvande: On the way to S-S17, Florian Streekluukva tried to memorise every turn. By the dugout door, he was simply glad someone else knew the way.
Florian Streekluukva discovered three men claiming the next place on the leave roster. Each had a different copy of the list.
News of the loss of Blackwater Canal reached S-S17 with the rations. Florian Streekluukva ate while listening to the revised orders.
sugar_cubes745: On Day 3, Zeno Cubes arrived during an argument about a missing spoon. The war already had matters more urgent than introductions.
Zeno Cubes put a flat stone under a short table leg. Supper stopped sliding toward the corporal.
Officers came to inspect R-F18. Zeno Cubes polished his buttons with mud, which is the only polish there is.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. A sniper's bullet hit Zeno Cubes at R-F18. The medics worked on him in the bottom of the trench and shouted for a stretcher. Zeno Cubes finally has a bed in the hospital dugout. A real blanket, a lamp, and a surgeon who has not slept. The surgeon worked on Zeno Cubes until the lamp ran dry. It was not enough.

A letter came with Gideon "Mud" Cubes: "I am Zeno Cubes's uncle. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes. On Day 6, Hill 304 passed to the Hegemony. Gideon "Mud" Cubes wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.
Dawn watch. Gideon "Mud" Cubes put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Wendel Yaboyslydude, grazed.
Gideon "Mud" Cubes had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Wendel Yaboyslydude crossed it, Gideon "Mud" Cubes fired. Wendel Yaboyslydude was badly wounded.

Gideon "Mud" Cubes borrowed the sergeant's periscope, found a target, handed it back, and fired. Lucien "Shadow" Jro was gravely wounded. Mail came up the line with a letter for Gideon "Mud" Cubes. Gideon "Mud" Cubes read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

The enemy post had been quiet all morning. Gideon "Mud" Cubes waited for that to change. When it did, Cyril "Brick" Jro was gravely wounded. Gideon "Mud" Cubes fired at a loophole in the enemy wall and heard a shout. It was Pavel Mvuisak, badly wounded. Mail came up the line with a letter for Gideon "Mud" Cubes. Gideon "Mud" Cubes read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

The raiders came over the parapet in the dark. Gideon "Mud" Cubes was hit hard in the fight at R-F18 before anyone could fire. The raider was Quentin "Hollow" Scottjseale of the Concord. Raider: Quentin "Hollow" Scottjseale of the Concord (@scottjseale). Gideon "Mud" Cubes crawled through a gap in the Concord wire and slid into their trench. Konrad Rachelejosia reached for a rifle. Gideon "Mud" Cubes was faster with the sharpened shovel. (@rachelejosiah) Gideon "Mud" Cubes threw a bomb into a Concord dugout and dived for cover. When the smoke cleared, Quentin "Hollow" Scottjseale was down and screaming for a medic. (@scottjseale) The Hegemony celebrated Gideon "Mud" Cubes's part in winning Blackwater Canal. He sat through the praise with a piece of ration bread still in his pocket.
theoneonlyfishboy: Valentin Theoneonlyfi arrived with the Day 10 draft, carrying a dented harmonica and the news from home, which was old by the time he told it.
tons355: The new sniper gave his name as Yann "Ash" Tons. The corporal looked at his boots, then at the mud, and laughed for the first time in a week.
Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Yann "Ash" Tons stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
victor_kabu: Clement Kabu came up on Day 9 carrying news from Port Abel. A man interrupted to ask whether the railway clock had been repaired.

The Hegemony secured Blackwater Canal. Clement Kabu helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly. Mail came up the line with a letter for Clement Kabu. Clement Kabu read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
